decisionContext.lockedTarget: People enact unity toward a purpose and elect a mayor who constrains them, so calling higher ontological realities merely emergent is insufficient.

components.text: People enact a form of unity by binding toward a purpose and electing a mayor.
The mayor enforces law on the people and thereby constrains downward on the parts.
Higher ontological realities can constrain the realities beneath them.
Calling the higher reality merely emergent is insufficient to explain that downward constraint.
